text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Three! Alright, Mission Space: "Must end 
every sentence with 'gepyoi' until 
reaching the next Mission Space"... A-Are 
you for real gepyoi...

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what language even is gepyoi!? An 
animal cry? 
Wait, each space is like ten meters long, 
right? The scale of this is insaneee!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Umm, then I'm next! A six! 
—Ah, looks like this'll take me right 
outside!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The two of you are making quite 
good time. 
Now, there are plenty more delights 
awaiting you ahead—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Further down the line, many more Mission 
Spaces will appear. 
Special missions might even be triggered.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And once you make it through the central 
plaza, the goal awaits at the gymnasium. 
Do your best, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's seriously a giant board game 
out here too!! 
Amaaaazing!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Five... and six! 
Let's see, this is... the "King's Space"?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Here, you shall obey royal decree. As for 
you... 
Hm, perform a song praising your King. An 
original piece or a parody matters not.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? L-Lady Orfevre!? A song... for you!? 
...A-Ah, then... here I go! —*Ahem*!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Beauty! Lady Orfevre~ forever~ shining 
bright~♪ 
Like, your aura is incredible and you're 
so strong in races~! Umm, uhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The spirit is there, but your 
execution lacks refinement. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Dear Sister. Show her how it is done.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You wish for *me* to sing?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You've gone through the trouble of 
dressing so splendidly. 
Surely dedicating a hymn of praise to me 
is a trivial matter, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... She's even putting her older 
sister on the spot... 
W-What's gonna happen...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ——Then, if I may.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
O proud, most beloved sister of mine♪ My 
brilliant, supreme sovereign King♪ Ah, 
your gaze pierces through all truths♪ 
Daily does your sagacious visage grow in 
gallant grace♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
——O proud, most beloved sister of mine♪ 
Full of majesty, ruling this domain♪ Ah, 
yet your spirit remains ever pure and 
clear, blazing brilliantly each day, 
holding all in thrall♪

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ——Mm.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Was that to your satisfaction? It was 
rather sudden, so I fear my deeper 
feelings may have bled through a little 
too much...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Praise from my dear sister is 
delightful as always. 
You shall sing for me again.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... The mental fortitude to 
endure that long piece... 
Wait, aren't those lyrics way too 
well-crafted!? I-I don't stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Ha! Right, my next space is... 
Ooh, the "King's Space"...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, quite the stroke of fortune. 
In that case, you—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Present me with a delectable sweet. 
Handmade by your own hands will suffice.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right now!? That's crazy pressure... wait, 
or is it a reward?? 
—A-Anyway, I'll go borrow the kitchen 
right away~~!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Finally close to the goal! 
I'm gonna sprint right through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Here goes! Let's see, move 4 spaces 
forward... 
"Perform a gag; miss a turn if it falls 
flat"!? Are you kidding me... !?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
As a challenger, obedience to all commands 
is absolute. 
Come, entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Orfevre-san! 
Even if it's a game, you shouldn't put 
people on the spot like—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. Then you shall serve as the pinch 
hitter. 
Step forward.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!? Mmmgh, if this is for the peace 
of Christmas...! 
Leave it to this officer! ————"The futon 
flew ten feet!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's a "Miss a Turn."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha ha ha! 
Good, splendid! A truly amusing dance, 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
For that very reason... a reward must be 
granted. 
————Now, the time has come to turn heaven 
and earth upside down.

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Whaaat—!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice. From this moment forth, the path 
of progression is reversed. 
Retrace every step you have taken.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh—!? After we came all this way—!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, look at that... 
Haha, feast your eyes, players. It's a 
dreamland packed to the brim with Reward 
Spaces.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall personally bestow rewards tailored 
to each space upon which you land. 
Go forth, and seize them.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible! There's tea leaves 
personally endorsed by Lady Orfevre! 
Whoa! A space where you get all the 
mahjong tiles signed by Nakayama-san...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nobody told me about this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's also a paper clay reindeer made by 
yours truly♡ 
You guys better fight with all you've got 
to win it☆

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh—you drew the "One-Day Vassal Ticket," 
did you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are now my loyal vassal— 
I grant you the honor of serving by my 
side as my closest attendant for a day.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the brilliance of my majesty 
shining upon you shall not be confined to 
a single day. 
I shall permit you to prostrate yourself 
before me for eternity. —Serve me well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. Your prize is "Goldwork," is it? 
A fine draw. I shall choose one for you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Given your features... 
Delicate craftwork should suit you best.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――Take this. I bestow upon you the honor 
of adorning your neck with it. 
Be sure to wear it whenever you are 
granted an audience with Us.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I got a training run ticket with 
Orfevre-senpai...! Awesomeee! 
I'm gonna stomp on every single present 
tile at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the next tile is―― 
'Ticket to Aim for the Comedy Summit with 
Gold Ship'!? M-Me...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! 
Good, good. Take back as much as you can 
carry.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Rewarding the people is also the duty of 
Us, their King. 
Tonight, We shall let you dream the 
supreme dream――
